rca of the issue: Root cause for unresolved issue: in SportsReplayRow#create, the heavy discovery call (SportsReplayRepository.discover) executes in the lifecycleScope loop context (main) after delay(300). Only account URL rewrite is offloaded with withContext(Dispatchers.Default). Repro: open game card with replay row attached/resumed and let replay loop execute; discovery/probe can compete with UI thread. Mitigation: wrap discover invocation in withContext(Dispatchers.Default) and keep cancellation checks before UI mutation.
